file.description: A text file of a gist.

name.description: Its name at the gist's root, with no /.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.repo record whose kind is gist, named by a new TID, in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, and commits the files given to its main branch in one commit, as `knotless gist create` does. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record and push themselves.

errors.description: No files, a file with no name or a name with a /, or two files of one name.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

description.description: What the gist is, shown above its files.

files.description: Its files, at the root of its main branch, each named once.

description: Creates a gist in the account logged in to this appview's pages.
